content:
Summer AirPods sales are in full swing. Even though the next-generation earbuds could be released as soon as in a month, which may drive prices down further, the AirPods Pro 3 have dropped to an all-time low price, while the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) have also fallen to near their lowest price in six months. The all-new AirPods Max 2, originally not expected until 2026, is now $120 off.

Within the next month, Apple is very likely to officially announce its next-generation in-ear personal audio device, but the company actually upgraded its over-ear headphones earlier this year, launching the all-new AirPods Max 2, which is now on sale at its lowest price ever.

  • AirPods Pro 3: $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2: $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation (ANC): $135 (original price $179) — the lowest price in six months
  • AirPods 4: $99 (original price $129)

Amazon is currently selling the AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping, a $120 discount off the original price of $549, making it one of the best prices since this headphone launched. Although a brief $399 deal appeared during Prime Day, stock and colour choices were quite limited at the time.

Best Buy is currently selling all five colours at a discounted price as part of a 60th anniversary celebration promotion that started this morning; Amazon is also expected to follow suit shortly.

  • AirPods Max 2 in all colours: $429 (original price $549)

Apple finally delivered a true next-generation upgrade to the AirPods Max earlier this year, though when a third generation will arrive remains unknown. The previous version was regarded by many as AirPods Max 1.5, with the main changes being a new look and a USB-C port; but this year's Max 2 brings significant spec upgrades, including a high dynamic range amplifier, and a listening experience powered by the Apple H2 chip — with Active Noise Cancellation performance improved by up to 1.5x, plus a new 'digital signal processing algorithm' to enhance Transparency mode performance.

We've previously detailed all the upgrades in full; here's a brief overview from Apple:

  • Adaptive Audio: Automatically adjusts the intensity of Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode based on the user's environment, delivering the optimal listening experience.
  • Conversation Awareness: Automatically lowers media volume and reduces background noise when the user starts talking to someone nearby.
  • Live Translation: Powered by Apple Intelligence, this feature helps users communicate face-to-face in different languages.
  • Voice Isolation: Uses advanced computational audio technology powered by the H2 chip to prioritise the user's voice during calls while blocking out ambient noise.
  • Camera Remote: Users can remotely capture photos and start and stop video recording by pressing the digital crown, via the Camera app on iPhone or iPad, or supported third-party camera apps.
  • Studio-Quality Audio Recording: Allows journalists, podcast hosts, singers, and other creators to record content with higher audio quality and a more natural vocal texture.
  • Hearing Protection: Helps users avoid exposure to loud environmental sounds while preserving the tonal qualities of what they're listening to.
  • Personalised Volume: Automatically fine-tunes the listening experience based on the user's long-term preferences.
  • Siri Interactions: Users can easily and privately respond to Siri prompts by simply nodding for 'yes' or shaking their head for 'no'.
